saveAs.title: Save project
saveAs.subtitle: A project is a folder with the settings and the processed image. The original frames stay where they are.
saveAs.name: Project name
saveAs.invalidName: The name contains only characters that cannot be used for a folder.
saveAs.cleanedName: Some characters are not allowed in folder names: the folder will be named “{name}”.
saveAs.alreadyExists: A project with this name already exists: saving will replace it.

confirm.title: Save your work?
confirm.close: If you close the project, the library and any unsaved adjustments will be lost.
confirm.new: If you start a new project, the library and any unsaved adjustments will be lost.
confirm.open: If you open another project, any unsaved work will be lost.
confirm.quit: If you quit StarLight, any unsaved work will be lost.
confirm.restart: If you restart StarLight, any unsaved work will be lost.
confirm.frame: If you open this frame, the processing applied to the image you are viewing will be lost unless you save the project.
confirm.frameResult: If you open this frame, the stacked image and its adjustments will be lost unless you save the project.
